video_title: Game 3 REACTION: Wemby Saves The Spurs’ Season With EPIC MSG Performance

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' defensive intensity and Victor Wembanyama's impact in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: The second half was a brilliant defensive half by the Spurs after they were really reeling.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: The second half was a brilliant defensive half by the Spurs after they were really reeling in the second quarter.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: The second half was a very smart half from the Spurs because in both quarters they got into the bonus very early and therefore they lived at the foul line.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' rebounding success due to the Knicks' stagnant offense
quotes.excerpt: They're going to get rebounds because the Knicks kept the ball on one side of the floor.
quotes.quote: What we saw tonight was they're going to get rebounds because the Knicks kept the ball on one side of the floor the whole game. I'm not sure what this new thing is, let's get rid of it. We call it the cat scan. I don't know if we've been talking about it and praising it too much and it made everybody feel like they need to be part of the game, but throwing the ball to the middle of the floor isn't just about cat getting in rhythm, it's also about not letting the defense load up.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's ability to manipulate defensive assignments
quotes.excerpt: Wemby shouldn't be able to pass people off when he's on a mismatch.
quotes.quote: Wemby shouldn't be able to pass people off when he's on a mismatch. Sometimes he's matched to the corner, he needs to have the respect that, and he's able to float and pass people off so that he can get back in front of the rim and make things tight. I just didn't understand it.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' lack of impact after early foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: Since Karl-Anthony Towns got that fourth foul in the third quarter of Game 3, he's been completely invisible.
quotes.quote: Since Karl-Anthony Towns got that fourth foul in the third quarter of Game 3, he's been completely invisible. He was not involved hardly at all today. I know he added up with 10 shots, but he was not in the mix in the game.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Castle's aggressive offensive approach against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I like the way Stefan Castle attacked tonight. He kept doing that slow gather.
quotes.quote: I like the way Stefan Castle attacked tonight. He kept doing that slow gather. The reason he kept doing it was because he's not trying to side-to-side him. They're driving him straight on. They got no worry about going over him, so they just go right into him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' need to be more aggressive and physical
quotes.excerpt: Carl-Anthony Towns, you have to do your job. There cannot be a time where there's a guard.
quotes.quote: Carl-Anthony Towns, you have to do your job. There cannot be a time where there's a guard six inches shorter than you able to keep you at the free throw line and y'all are just arm wrestling. Nothing's happening. If you arm wrestle for a second, you don't get the ball, run down to the post. You don't get it there, spin and pin. This has to be one, two, three.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The league's officiating and the need for physical play
quotes.excerpt: This is why the league has turned the way it's turned.
quotes.quote: This is why the league has turned the way it's turned. I've had stuff like that happen to me, but that's when your big man that comes off the bench has a problem with that. It's like, listen, it's a Kendrick Perkins play, but when he checks in, you go right to the ref and you say, you clean it up or I clean it up. You saw him get hit in the face, that's our guy. You want me to hit somebody in the face? You know what I'm saying? But that's what it becomes, and I don't mean to turn it into fighting or nothing like that, but I mean, your guys got to ride for you.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' poor offensive execution and costly fouls
quotes.excerpt: It's not about the fouls as much as it was just poor offense.
quotes.quote: It's not about the fouls as much as it was just poor offense. And again, I go back to the start of that fourth quarter. Mike Brown, you cannot come back after four minutes of Jose Alvarado and Jordan Clarkson, which already was way too much, and have them out there at the start of that quarter. It's a disaster. He got lucky with that in Game 2, he got high on his own supply in this game, he went to it again, and that's where the game was lost.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's struggle to adapt his game when his shot isn't falling
quotes.excerpt: I've never seen Jalen Brunson look that uncomfortable with bringing the ball up.
quotes.quote: I've never seen Jalen Brunson look that uncomfortable with bringing the ball up or making plays, penetrating. He seemed really uncomfortable like all he wanted to do was shoot threes, and I felt like he should have recognized immediately, Jalen Brunson is in foul trouble, I need to switch my game over, become a little bit more of a distributor. He did that when he was playing in Miami. I've seen him have plenty of games where he's penetrated, made the right play, made the right reads. He's got to get back in his bag and do that, especially if Jalen Brunson is struggling.
